title: localfix: hub requires frank_aad 0x0020 in the room's required safe_aad list
description: Per rohanmahy on mimi-protocol#166 (2026-10-19): 'if your implementation requires franking, then include 0x0020 as a required component'. mimid's hub requires a frank_aad item on every message (hub/submit.rs:94, :275-287; mandatory franking), but room creation (hub/room.rs) never checks that the GroupContext safe_aad list (mls-extensions-10 §5, required Safe AAD components) contains 0x0020, so a member that doesn't understand frank_aad can be in a room whose messages the hub then refuses. Fix: create_room refuses a group whose GroupContext safe_aad list lacks 0x0020; check commits that change it (GroupContextExtensions/AppDataUpdate of safe_aad) the same way; test fixtures that build groups with an empty list (e.g. mimi-mls tests Member::create(.., &[(SAFE_AAD, vec![0x00])])) are only affected where they go through the hub. Regression test first. Also give mimi-mls's group-creation helpers a way to set the required list including 0x0020 for the agent (.13).
design:
PLAN (2026-11-02, awaiting Mark; implement after the running .2.26/.2.25 and krmn K1 agents land, since it touches mimi-mls observer and shared hub test fixtures). rohanmahy on mimi-protocol#166: an implementation that requires franking includes 0x0020 as a required Safe AAD component. mimid's hub requires a frank_aad item on every message (hub/submit.rs) but never checks the GroupContext safe_aad list.
1. mimi-mls (owns OpenMLS, so the hub cannot decode openmls::component::ComponentsList itself): an Observer accessor for the required safe_aad component IDs of the current epoch and of the pending Commit's resulting epoch (GREASE excluded, decoded strictly as required_lists does). Minimal surface; no other API.
2. Hub: check_group (room creation, hub/room.rs) refuses a group whose safe_aad list lacks 0x0020 (new HubError variant, e.g. FrankAadNotRequired); hub update (hub/update.rs, before merge_pending_commit at ~452) refuses a Commit whose resulting safe_aad list lacks 0x0020 via the existing refused() path (state unchanged).
3. Regression tests first: room creation with no safe_aad / a list without 0x0020 refused, with 0x0020 accepted; a Commit (from an mls-rs member or a plain OpenMLS client, independent of mimid's committer) changing safe_aad to drop 0x0020 refused, one keeping it accepted.
4. Fixture cascade: tests/common build_group adds (SAFE_AAD, ComponentsList[0x0020]) by default; hub tests whose mls-rs/OpenMLS leaves must then list 0x0020 in their safe_aad list (leaf conformance) are updated; follower_e2e already uses FRANK_AAD_ONLY. Each fixture change is required by the new rule and listed.
No group-creation API change in mimi-mls: Member::create already takes (SAFE_AAD, list) components.
notes: 2026-11-04: invariant revised by decision mimid-1wgh.4.76.2 (hub accepts -11 §5.1 built-in component updates; checks the required Safe AAD before merge).
close_reason: Hub refuses room creation whose GroupContext safe_aad list lacks frank_aad 0x0020 (HubError::FrankAadNotRequired) via new Observer::required_safe_aad (reuses required_lists). Pre-merge Commit check omitted from the approved plan with orchestrator review: no accepted Commit can change safe_aad (policy denies GroupContextExtensions; apply_commit_op rejects AppDataUpdate of 0x0002); hub_update test commit_dropping_frank_aad_from_safe_aad_is_refused pins that. Test create_room_requires_frank_aad_in_safe_aad failed first. Fixture cascade (safe_aad [0x0020] default, mls-rs leaves list 0x0020, empty SafeAAD on mls-rs handshakes per ext-10 §4.9, suite fixtures regenerated by their generator). Six gates pass on main.
